predictions.transcription: Namaskar, IIT Gandhi Nagar voice help desk. I am facing a serious internet connectivity issue on my laptop. The campus wifi connects successfully but websites are loading very slowly and sometimes the connection gets disconnected automatically. This has been happening since yesterday evening and I restarted my laptop and forgot the network before connecting again but nothing seems to have changed. My online lectures and assignments are getting very difficult to complete. I also tried using the wifi in another location on campus but the speed was still. Could you please check whether there is a network issue or if I need to update my settings on my phone. Please let me know if I should visit the IT support office or submit online complaint. I need a stable connection for my academic work. So an early reservation would be very helpful. Thank you.

नमस्ते मैं अपने भेटे के लिये वोश्तिल अवर काने पिने की स्विदा के बारे में कुँच-कुच लेना चाता हूं अगर उस से आदमिशन अयाटी गन्दी नगर में मिल जाता है तो वह पेली बार गर से दूर निकल राहे पडाई के लिए विद्धर्तियो की बोजन की ज फ़ता क्या है? क्या मेस में आस्ता दोपर में खाना अव राछ को खाना नेमित रुब से मिलता है क्या? मेस का शुल वोष्तल फीज के सातिक जमा करना परता है? या वोक्ताथ करना परता है? अश्टल्फीज्के सातिक जमा करना परता है या आलक से भुभ्तान तरना परता है मेरे बेटे को कुछ खाद्दे पदार्थो की परशानी है इसिले हम ये भी जान राचाते है कै क्या विषेश भोजन की आवश्च्ता होने पर सम्मन्दित अदिकारियो से बाद की जा सकती है प्रुपय करके उसके संपर के नम्बर बताएए इसके अलावा अगर विद्धर थी चुट्टिव में गर आस्व धाता है तो उसी दवरान मेस की शुल्क के नीम क्या है यस के बारे में प्रुपय करके है बार्दिर ज़श्यन करे

Hello, I need some assistance regarding the hostel service in my hostel. I tried using the washing machine yesterday but the payment was deducted from my account and the machine did not start. I tried to pay twice but the machine didn't work. I waited for some time and checked whether the machine was working but there was no change. Could you please tell me how I can request a refund for the failed transactions? I also want to know whether I can use another machine until this issue is resolved. Please guide me through the complete process and let me know if I need to provide the transaction details.

Hello help desk. I am looking for a particular textbook that I need for an upcoming semester examination. I searched the library catalog online and the book appears in the reason. But I am unable to determine whether a physical copy is currently available. And the catalog also mentioned different editions. And I am not sure which edition is recommended by my post. I have to go to the book early for exam preparation because the exams schedule has already been announced and could you please explain how I can check the real-time availability of the book and whether the student can reserve a copy online. If all physical copies are currently issued, is there an option to access an electronic vision through the institute library. I would also like to know boring the period and whether I can renew the book if I need for the long duration please guide me through the process. Thank you.
